06/Dated: 15.03.2024 I.A. No.6233 of 2023 Heard the parties.

This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail under Section
389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, during the pendency Criminal Appeal (S.J.) No.
469/2023.
The appellant Irshad Ansari has faced trial in connection with POCSO Case No.139/2021, arising out of Mandar P.S. Case No.116/2021.

After trial, the appellant was held guilty by shri Asif Equbal,
learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-IV-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Ranchi, by judgment dated 25.05.2023 under Sections 376/511, 354(A) & 354(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 8 of the POCSO Act and thereby, sentenced to to undergo R.I for two years for the offence under Section 354(A) of the Indian Penal Code.

He was further sentenced to undergo R.I for three years alongwith a fine of Rs.5,000/- for the offence under Section 354(B) of the Indian Penal Code and further sentenced to undergo R.I for five years alongwith a fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offences under Sections 376/511 of the Indian Penal Code.
No separate sentence was passed under Section 8 of the POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant has remained in custody for about two years and seven months and as such, he has served half of the sentence.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail but does not dispute the aforesaid fact.
